title: Directors who stayed in one genre
statementMd:
List directors whose movies all belong to a single genre and who made at least two movies.

Expected columns: `name`, `genre`, `movies`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name, MIN(m.genre) AS genre, COUNT(*) AS movies FROM directors d JOIN movies m ON m.director_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.genre) = 1 AND COUNT(*) >= 2;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
